note: The external legs' cost table (scripts/schedule.py pack-external), refreshed by PR from named runs. A tool priced per object (object_min) is cut into object legs of about target_leg_min each, longest object first; every other tool runs as one leg of job_min. Each leg's timeout is max(timeout_floor_min, ceil(timeout_factor x predicted)), capped at GitHub's 360-minute job limit (a capped leg is printed as such, and a leg predicted to reach the limit is refused). A stale table costs balance and timeout margin, never results.

kete.source: MEASURED per object on the hosted runner: kete_time_ms summed over the object's rows (the runner replays rows serially and fits once per object and epoch, so each fit is counted once), per object the larger of runs 44355534056 and 44429779551; the sums match each leg's Run step to 0.1 min. setup_min is the larger job start to Run step over every leg of both runs (0.5 to 0.95 min); leg_overhead_min the larger of the Run step minus the summed object times, plus the steps after it (0.15 to 0.23 min). Iris, Vesta, Pallas and Hygiea are named unsupported and never run. An object not in the table is priced at the mean of the 46 objects that run, 1.492 min.

oorb.source: job wall, max of runs 44355534056 and 44429779551 (133.4 and 132.1); the one leg runs its rows as concurrent oorb processes, so it is priced whole

layup.source: job wall of run 39726274647, the only full run in which layup completed

jorbit.source: MEASURED per object on the hosted runner: each object's wall from the runner's own log, its 'object: N rows' line to the next, one worker process per object run serially, per object the larger of runs 44355534056 and 44429779551. That wall includes the worker start, the geocentre ephemeris and failed calls; jorbit_time_ms alone omits them (2024 PT5's four failed propagations cost about 6 min it does not record). The walls sum to each leg's Run step within 0.6 min. setup_min is the larger job start to Run step over every leg of both runs (0.45 to 1.55 min); leg_overhead_min the larger of the Run step minus the summed object walls, plus the steps after it (0.06 to 0.21 min). An object that never runs (the four named unsupported) is priced at 0. An object not in the table is priced at the mean of the 46 objects that run, 5.503 min.

orbfit.source: orbfit_time_ms per object, run 42506609035 (sum 42.3 min against a 43.7 min job; three objects hit the 600 s neofit2.x timeout). An object with no time failed at the fixture lookup and is priced at 0.01 min. setup_min is the measured image pull (34 to 85 s).

adam-core.source: MEASURED per object on the hosted runner: adam_core_wall_s (the OD child's wall; fits run serially) plus the object's adam_core_time_ms over its propagation and ephemeris rows, per object the larger of runs 44355534056 and 44429779551; the sums match each leg's Run step to 0.2 min. 67P and 46P/Wirtanen reached the 30-minute per-object cap in both runs (the kill measured 30.02 min) and are priced at the cap. setup_min is the larger job start to Run step over every leg of both runs (0.5 to 1.47 min); leg_overhead_min the larger of the Run step minus the summed object walls, plus the steps after it (0.12 to 0.34 min). An object not in the table is priced at the mean of the 50 objects, 3.508 min.

adam-core-rust.source: MEASURED per object on the hosted runner: adam_core_rust_wall_s (the OD child's wall; fits run serially) plus the object's adam_core_rust_time_ms over its non-OD rows, per object the larger of runs 44355534056 and 44429779551; the sums match each leg's Run step to 0.1 min. 67P and 46P/Wirtanen reached the 30-minute per-object cap in both runs (the kill measured 30.01 min) and are priced at the cap. setup_min is the larger job start to Run step over every leg of both runs: 3.9 min on run 44355534056, which built the runner cold (0.8 to 1.4 min on run 44429779551, a tool-cache hit); leg_overhead_min the larger of the Run step minus the summed object walls, plus the steps after it (0.1 to 0.19 min). An object not in the table is priced at the mean of the 46 objects that run, 3.571 min.
